## Activity

During May 2026, River Outreach completed 62 captures. This records the site’s activity for the month and provides the basis for review of image quality and grading performance. The captures were submitted for assessment through the usual operational process.

## Image quality

Graders marked 2 captures as ungradable. The ungradable rate was 3.2. This result should be reviewed alongside the operational circumstances recorded at the site. The clinic lead asks that recurring camera issues are logged with the service desk so that they can be monitored and addressed through the appropriate channel.

## Grading

Grading identified 11 referable results. The median lag from capture to grading was 1 day. This measure indicates the central turnaround time for the month. The referable results and the grading lag should continue to be monitored as part of routine site operations, with any recurring issues documented for follow-up.
